method.physical_lines: len(raw_bytes.splitlines()); same checkout input as candidate-src-identity
method.code_lines: unique physical lines occupied by non-comment Python tokens, excluding module/class/function docstring lines; multiline code tokens count each occupied line
method.statements: ast.stmt nodes across exactly the seven files; includes class/function definitions and docstring expression statements
method.branches: syntactic node counts, separately If/IfExp/loops/handlers/comprehensions; bool continuations are len(values)-1; not runtime branch visits, coverage, or cyclomatic complexity
method.fields: class-scope annotated fields only; actual storage/state ownership reviewed manually
method.symbol_counts: changed function own_counts exclude nested function/class bodies; outer and nested symbols must not be summed as physical diff
method.execution: standard-library AST/tokenize/hash and git read-only comparison; no compared source/tests imported and no benchmark/test run
